(function (global) {
    'use strict';

    // A web app manifest holds one name, so the installed app's name is localized by pointing the
    // page's manifest link at the manifest of the page's language (generated by
    // scripts/build-manifests.js from each language file's header.title). The default manifest
    // stays in the page until the language is known.
    const DEFAULT_HREF = '/devocionales/manifest.webmanifest';

    function hrefFor(lang, supported) {
        return supported.includes(lang) ? `/devocionales/manifests/${lang}.webmanifest` : DEFAULT_HREF;
    }

    function init(doc, win) {
        const link = doc.querySelector('link[rel="manifest"]');
        if (!link || !win.DevotionalI18n) return;
        // window.i18n is created after this runs, so it is read when the language is needed.
        const sync = () => {
            if (!win.i18n) return;
            link.href = hrefFor(win.i18n.currentLang, Object.keys(win.i18n.supportedLanguages || {}));
        };
        win.DevotionalI18n.whenReady(sync);
        win.DevotionalI18n.onLanguageChanged(sync);
    }

    global.DevotionalManifest = { init, hrefFor };
})(window);
